MISSION VIEJO MINUTES
  City Council, Community Development Agency,
  Community Development Financing Authority,
  Public Improvement Corporation,
  and Library Board of Trustees*

  February 16, 2009

A Regular Meeting of the City Council, the Community Development Agency, the Community
Development Financing Authority, the Public Improvement Corporation, and the Library Board
of Trustees of the City of Mission Viejo, California, was called to order by Mayor Ury at 5:02
p.m., on February 16, 2009 at 200 Civic Center, Mission Viejo, California.

A complete copy of the agenda for the meeting containing all items as shown herein was posted
by 5:00 p.m. on February 11, 2009, on the outdoor bulletin board at City Hall. Copies were also
posted at the Montanoso Recreation and Fitness Center, 25800 Montanoso Drive, and the
Norman P. Murray Community and Senior Center, 24932 Veterans Way.

*All Board and Agency memberships are reflected in the title "Council Member."

Present:  Council Member Kelley
  Council Member Ledesma
  Council Member Schlicht
  Mayor Pro Tem MacLean (arrived at 5:05 p.m.)
  Mayor Ury

Absent:  None

Staff Present:  Dennis Wilberg, City Manager
  Irwin Bornstein, Assistant City Manager/Director of Admin. Services
  William P. Curley III, City Attorney
  Karen Hamman, City Clerk

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Council Member Kelley

INVOCATION: Council Member Schlicht

CLOSED SESSION

  Larry Gilbert, M.V.: in reference to Closed Session item CS1, Mr. Gilbert stated that the
  city should not get involved in real property business.

City Council Minutes  1  February 16, 2009
 CS1. Conference With Real Property Negotiator Pursuant To Government Code Section
  54956.8. Property: An approximate 7.4 net acre site identified as Assessor Parcel
  No. 809 541 11, Parcel Map No. 81-159 generally situated easterly of the intersection
  of Jeronimo Road and Los Alisos Boulevard in the City of Mission Viejo owned by
  the Target Corporation. CDA Negotiators: Dennis Wilberg, City Manager/CDA
  Executive Director, Charles Wilson, Director of Community Development, James
  Williams, Economic Advisor, Celeste Brady, CDA Counsel, and William Curley,
  III, Esq., City Attorney. Owner’s Negotiators: On behalf of Target Corporation CB
  Richard Ellis Representatives:  Suzanne Washburn, Senior Vice President,
  Raymond Eldridge, Senior Vice President, Wood Belcher, First Vice President, and
  Michelle Jefcoat, Senior Sales Director. Under Negotiation: Consideration of
  Offering Memorandum for potential acquisition of real property interests for long
  term affordable housing purposes and the price and terms of payment therefore
  related to the above-listed Property. Factors Affecting Price and Terms under
  Negotiation: Recorded Covenants, Scope of Development of Property, and
  Affordable Housing Requirements. Factors affecting time of payment: Conditions
  to Closing. Due diligence Period, and Schedule of Development of Affordable
  Housing.
CS2. Conference With Real Property Negotiator Pursuant To Government Code Section
  54956.8. Property: An approximate 7.12 acre site generally located at the
  intersection of Oso Parkway and Montanoso Drive, adjacent to Mission Viejo
  Country Club and owned by Watermarke Properties, Inc. CDA Negotiators: Dennis
  Wilberg, City Manager/CDA Executive Director, Charles Wilson, Director of
  Community Development, James Williams, Economic Advisor, Celeste Brady, CDA
  Counsel, and William Curley, III, Esq., City Attorney. Owner’s Negotiators: Salim
  Rahemtulla, Watermarke Properties, Inc., and Jeffrey M. Oderman, Rutan &
  Tucker, Counsel to Owner. Under Negotiation: Potential Acquisition and/or
  Disposition of Real Property Interests for Long Term Affordable Housing and the
  Price and Terms of Payment Therefore Related to the Above-Listed Property.
  Factors Affecting Price and Terms under Negotiation: Recorded Covenants, Scope
  of Development of Property, and Affordable Housing Requirements. Factors
  affecting time of payment: Conditions to Closing, Due Diligence Period, and
  Schedule of Development of Affordable Housing.

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION AND RECONVENE

At the hour of 5:05 p.m., Mayor Ury recessed the meeting to Closed Session. The City Council
reconvened at 6:03 p.m. with all five City Council Members present.

REPORT OF CLOSED SESSION

City Attorney Bill Curley announced that staff received direction from the City Council but there
was nothing to report from Closed Session.

City Council Minutes  5  February 16, 2009
 COUNCIL MEMBER COMMENTS

15.  Council Member Reports of Events and Activities Attended

  The City Council Members acknowledged their event and activities calendars as
  presented in the staff report and agreed to provide any changes to the City Clerk for the
  public record.

Council Member Kelley

Council Member Kelley announced that she has asked the Mayor and the City Clerk to place an
item on future City Council Agendas so she can provide an update on her attendance at the
SCAG Transportation and Communications Committee (TCC) Meetings. In the meantime, she
provided an update on the last TCC Meeting and she stated that SCAG is looking at the
Economic Stimulus bill to see how it might impact SCAG’s work. SCAG is positioned to
implement an amendment to its Regional Transportation Plan (RTP) to bring in additional
projects through the Economic Stimulus package. She announced that the Committee received a
presentation on key points of the Foothill South Extension project and they have requested a
more detailed presentation at their next meeting in March. Council Member Kelley
complimented Mayor Ury on his State of the City speech at the Chamber of Commerce breakfast
last week. She also outlined her attendance with Mayor Ury and Mayor Pro Tem MacLean at a
League of California Cities event last week. The panel of speakers discussed the Economic
Stimulus bill and informed the audience that most cities will not see funds from the package.
Council Member Kelley congratulated Jason Harnett, City of Mission Viejo tennis coach who
was named Coach of the Year for 2008 by the International Wheelchair Tennis Association. She
expressed her condolences to the families of two young men who were killed in a car crash this
last week in Mission Viejo. Finally, Council Member Kelley announced that the Community of
Character Word for the month of February is unity.

Council Member Ledesma

Council Member Schlicht

16.  Quarterly Check Register Report

  By consensus, the City Council directed staff to provide deposit history reports in
  addition to quarterly check register reports.

City Council Minutes  6  February 16, 2009
 Council Member Schlicht read an email she received from a resident requesting assistance with
traffic issues at Madera and Via Linda and stated that she would forward the email to the City
Manager for follow-up. She discussed her attendance at the recent CUSD Board Meeting and
inquired about a City of Mission Viejo letter of recommendation for consultant Tony Ingegneri
of ATS Communications. Council Member Schlicht asked Mayor Ury to expand the Roundabout
Intersections Committee from an ad hoc to a standing committee so traffic committee members
and interested residents can attend. She noted her attendance at recent meetings with several
community groups, including a luncheon with the Elks, the Roundabout and Check Register
Committee meetings, the CUSD Board Meeting and the Lincoln luncheon at Casta del Sol. She
also announced that she was interviewed by a Mission Viejo Boy Scout who is working on a
merit badge. Council Member Schlicht thanked Paul Catsimanes for the tour he provided of the
city’s Emergency Operations Center and Fire Chief Scott Brown who provided a tour of the fire
facilities. She ended her comments by reading a bio of Martin “Marty” Russo who recently
passed away and she proposed to rename the Youth Athletic Park in Mr. Russo’s name and
asked her City Council colleagues to concur.

Mayor Pro Tem MacLean

Mayor Pro Tem MacLean complimented Mayor Ury on the great message that he delivered at
the recent Chamber of Commerce Mayor’s breakfast. He stated that it is important to compare
and contrast what we have here in Mission Viejo with what is happening at the Federal and State
levels. In Mission Viejo we have a balanced budget, $28 or $30 million in reserves and we
continue to provide services to the residents. Members of the business community who attended
the breakfast were happy to hear that the City of Mission Viejo is doing quite well and this is a
valuable message to also share with residents. Mayor Pro Tem MacLean requested that the
meeting be adjourned in honor of resident Louis C. Knoke.

Mayor Ury

Thanked his colleagues for their kind words regarding the Mayor's breakfast and members of the
Chamber of Commerce for planning and attending. He expressed his appreciation to Karen
Wylie for her assistance with the speech and the pamphlet of highlights. Mayor Ury announced
that he and Council Member Kelley have the opportunity to go parachuting with the Army's
Golden Eagles and he looks forward to that experience. He discussed the budget problems at the
State and Federal levels and stated that the City Council Members must be vigilant in promoting
the city and that the Economic Development Committee is going to be valuable in this regard.

In follow-up to Council Member Schlicht’s request, Mayor Ury directed that the Roundabout
Intersections Committee be converted from an ad hoc committee to a standing committee.

City Council Minutes  7  February 16, 2009
 Mayor Ury requested that the City Council members consult their calendars for a workshop next
week to discuss Mission Viejo's housing requirements. By consensus, the meeting was set for
Tuesday, February 24, 2009 at 6:00 p.m.

ADJOURNMENT

At the hour of 7:29 p.m., there being no further business to come before the City Council at this
session, Mayor Ury adjourned the meeting in memory of Marty Russo and Louis C. Knoke to
Tuesday, February 24, 2009, at 6:00 p.m.
